Bill.BriefDescription: Modifying oyster harvest requirements for certain persons of disability.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to oyster harvesting; and adding a new section tochapter 77.32 RCW.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 77.32 RCWto read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: A person of disability, age sixtyfive or older, may take the dailylimit of oysters off the beach without shucking the oysters.
